mintAuthority.summary: WTGXX has eight independently mint-capable native deployments across Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Plume, Stellar, and Solana. Each EVM token gates mint/burn through REGISTRAR_ROLE held by 0x726D3b3e18e301719b383FdE4F99A5d31B9438e5, while DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by 0x6257759edD99f677052727f7Ef3a055029DFA58a administers roles and upgrades the local custom beacon. Stellar WTGX (anchored to WTGXX per stellar.toml) issues directly under the issuer master/operational Ed25519 signers, and Solana Token-2022 mint Em46fxxwgY2RRoUbBMSbEjJwY62x3ESMNdhnsGpEKewm retains a live EOA mintAuthority.
